page_title: TOR 0-2 ROM | Torino v AS Roma 25/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+1' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Leandro Paredes as he is replaced by Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma).
90+1' Claudio Ranieri has decided to make a change. Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) replaces Alexis Saelemaekers.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' A substitution has been made. Zeki Celik (AS Roma) is replaced by Mats Hummels.
90' It will be a substitution. Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) is ready to enter the pitch as Matias Soule walks off.
89' Marco Di Bello blows for a foul after Karol Linetty (Torino) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
87' OFF THE POST! Good play from Che Adams (Torino) as skips past two defending players and from the edge of the box unleashes a decent strike that smashes the left post!
85' The goal by AS Roma won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
85' The AS Roma players halt their celebrations as referee Marco Di Bello makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
84' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and scores with aplomb into the top right corner. What a perfect shot.
81' We are about to witness a subsitution. Tommaso Gabellini (Torino) for Eljif Elmas.
80' The goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to deny Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) as he jumps for a header from a brilliant cross into the penalty area.
78' Mile Svilar pulls off a decent save! Che Adams (Torino) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the middle of the net, but the effort is kept out.
76' Sergiu Perciun (Torino) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Mile Svilar is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
75' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
72' Here comes a substitution. Adam Masina is given a rest as he is replaced by Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino).
72' Paolo Vanoli has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Karol Linetty (Torino) replacing Samuele Ricci.
72' That's the end of the game for Eldor Shomurodov, who is replaced by Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma).
69' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
69' The game is interrupted. One of the players from AS Roma is cautioned for aggressive play.
68' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
66' Matias Soule (AS Roma) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just wide of the left post.
63' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
63' PENALTY APPEAL by Torino, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
59' Paolo Vanoli has decided to substitute Ali Dembele (Torino) and he is replaced by Sergiu Perciun.
59' The referee allows time for a substitution. Cesare Casadei (Torino) will be replaced by Gvidas Gineitis.

57' Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the bottom left corner. Vanja Milinkovic-Savic is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
57' Some neat passing and movement from AS Roma as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.

53' 0 - 2 Goal! A nice lofted pass into the box by Matias Soule is pounced on by Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma). His close-range strike flashes past Vanja Milinkovic-Savic and into the bottom left corner. 0:2.
52' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post.
51' Torino concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
50' Adam Masina (Torino) shows brilliant individual skill to find some space and tries his luck from long range, but the shot flies high over the bar.
48' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
47' Che Adams (Torino) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
46' Here is a change. Zeki Celik is going off and Claudio Ranieri gives the last tactical orders to Mats Hummels (AS Roma).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+1' Samuele Ricci (Torino) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
42' The game is interrupted. Samuele Ricci (Torino) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
42' Che Adams (Torino) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
40' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
37' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) tackles a bit over-zealously and Marco Di Bello blows for a foul.
35' Matias Soule (AS Roma) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
34' Marco Di Bello has a clear sight and sees a foul from Nikola Vlasic (Torino).
33' A player from Torino commits a rough challenge. Marco Di Bello blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
31' The ball is cleared after Manu Kone (AS Roma) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
29' Torino fail to score from a corner as Mile Svilar (AS Roma) leaps to collect the ball.

28' A nice individual effort by Ali Dembele (Torino) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender. Torino have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
24' AS Roma have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
23' Manu Kone (AS Roma) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
22' A corner kick by Torino is thwarted by the well prepared Mile Svilar (AS Roma).

21' Samuele Ricci (Torino) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The ball is out of play. Torino win a corner kick.
18' 0 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Vanja Milinkovic-Savic no chance!
18' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) is going to take the penalty!
15' Ali Dembele (Torino) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY to AS Roma!
12' He should have scored! Che Adams (Torino) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
12' A pass from Matias Soule (AS Roma) is intercepted by Vanja Milinkovic-Savic and the move breaks down.
10' Excellent touch by Matias Soule (AS Roma)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post.
9' A precise low pass is received by Leandro Paredes (AS Roma), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the left post.
7' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) runs onto a pass and from the edge of the box tries his luck with a dipping shot. Unfortunately for him, the effort fizzes just over the bar.
5' A cross into the box from Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is cleared.
5' Angelino (AS Roma) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
4' Che Adams (Torino) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
2' A pass by Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! AS Roma will take the kick-off.
Marco Di Bello is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
